description: This PHP source file defines the MailerSubscriber class, which is an event subscriber in the OrangeHRM system. It listens for the kernel termination event and, based on cache conditions, triggers the sending of all pending emails via the EmailQueueService.

classes.name: MailerSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber that listens for kernel termination events and triggers email sending if the cache indicates so. Implements performance logging for email dispatch.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping kernel events to handler methods, specifically subscribing to the TERMNATE event.

methods.name: onTerminateEvent
methods.description: Handles the kernel terminate event; checks cache, and if set, sends all pending emails through EmailQueueService, then updates cache and logs execution details.
